title.english: Which Way the Sign Should Face

pairs.target: mùjiàng xiān bǎ ruǎn héng dì lái de tú dǎo le guòlái .
pairs.english: The carpenter first reversed Ruanheng's drawing.
pairs.hanzi: 木匠先把阮衡递来的图倒了过来。

pairs.target: " nǐ zhàn zài jiē lǐ huà de .
pairs.english: “You drew it from the street.
pairs.hanzi: “你站在街里画的。

pairs.target: zhuāng de shíhòu , rén dé zhàn zhèbiān . "
pairs.english: For installation we stand here.”
pairs.hanzi: 装的时候，人得站这边。”

pairs.target: tā jiāng liǎngkuài duǎn mù fàngdào dìshàng , bǎi chū zhuǎnjiē chù xīnlù pái de wèizhì .
pairs.english: He put two short boards down to show the new transfer-point sign's position.
pairs.hanzi: 他将两块短木放到地上，摆出转接处新路牌的位置。

pairs.target: pái shì gěi chūn shì línshí yòng de , jiào xièhuò chē zài qiánmiàn de kòngdì tíng , búyào yíliàngliàng zuānjìn zhùhù ménqián .
pairs.english: The sign was temporary for the spring market, directing unloading carts to the open ground ahead instead of household doorways.
pairs.hanzi: 牌是给春市临时用的，叫卸货车在前面的空地停，不要一辆辆钻进住户门前。

pairs.target: lù méi tuòkuān , xiān dé ràng rén cóng yuǎnchù jiù zhīdào nǎér gāi zhuǎn .
pairs.english: The road wasn't wider; people first needed to know where to turn from a distance.
pairs.hanzi: 路没拓宽，先得让人从远处就知道哪儿该转。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi zhàn zài pángbiān kàn , xiǎngdào zìjǐ zài xuéxiào wèn guò , yíjiàn zuòhǎo de dōngxī wèishénme háiyào jiào biérén huàn gè fāngxiàng ná .
pairs.english: Watching, Tavi remembered asking at school why a finished object needed turning for someone else.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维站在旁边看，想到自己在学校问过，一件做好的东西为什么还要叫别人换个方向拿。

pairs.target: rújīn rén cóng nǎbiān zǒulái , zhēnde néng jiāng tóng yìzhāng tú biànchéng liǎnghuíshì .
pairs.english: Now the direction people approached really made one drawing into two different things.
pairs.hanzi: 如今人从哪边走来，真的能将同一张图变成两回事。

pairs.target: ruǎn héng méiyǒu zhēng , gēnzhe rào dào mùjiàng zhàn de wèizhì , bǎ pái miàn hé xíngrén guò chù chóngxīn duì le yíbiàn .
pairs.english: Ruanheng didn't argue, walking to the carpenter's viewpoint to check sign and pedestrian passage again.
pairs.hanzi: 阮衡没有争，跟着绕到木匠站的位置，把牌面和行人过处重新对了一遍。

pairs.target: shū yàn xiānqián dài tāmen kàn de nà tiáoshí yán , liúxiàlái bú fàng jiǎojià , bēilǒu de rén búyòng wèi kàn yíkuài xīn pái zài wǎng jiē zhōngjiān duǒ .
pairs.english: The stone edge Shuyan had shown stayed clear of supports; basket carriers wouldn't have to dodge into the street for a new sign.
pairs.hanzi: 舒砚先前带他们看的那条石沿，留下来不放脚架，背篓的人不用为看一块新牌再往街中间躲。

pairs.target: shàngwǔ xiān zài gōngzuò dì liáng , xiàwǔ cái huí kèzhàn hòuyuàn zhuāngpèi zhījià .
pairs.english: Morning measurements came first, afternoon assembly in the inn yard.
pairs.hanzi: 上午先在工作地量，下午才回客栈后院装配支架。

pairs.target: mù jiàn yóu dāngdì mùjiàng zuò , jǐzhī xiǎo kòujiàn shì suǒ lǐ dàilái de biāozhǔnjiàn , pèi zài yǐ chá hǎo de jiājù shàng , gēn zhènshàng de jiù dà jiàzi quán wú guānxì .
pairs.english: Local carpentry supplied wood, the office supplied standard small clasps for the checked fixture, unrelated to the town's giant old frame.
pairs.hanzi: 木件由当地木匠做，几只小扣件是所里带来的标准件，配在已查好的夹具上，跟镇上的旧大架子全无关系。

pairs.target: luó dí bào zhe mùliào huílái , jiàn ruǎn héng dǎkāi tiěxiá , xiān wèn yòng pǔtōng luó jiá bùxíng ma , zìjǐ yǒu yìzhī .
pairs.english: Returning with wood, Luodi saw Ruanheng open the iron case and asked if an ordinary screw clamp would do; he had one.
pairs.hanzi: 罗荻抱着木料回来，见阮衡打开铁匣，先问用普通螺夹不行吗，自己有一只。

pairs.target: " yǒu yíchù shēn bú jìn luógǎn . "
pairs.english: “One spot won't admit the screw,”
pairs.hanzi: “有一处伸不进螺杆。”

pairs.target: ruǎn héng shuō , zhǐ gěi tā kàn , " biéde dōu yòng nǐ de .
pairs.english: Ruanheng showed him. “Yours everywhere else.
pairs.hanzi: 阮衡说，指给他看，“别的都用你的。

pairs.target: bùnéng wèile dàilái qìjù , jiù chùchù yào tā lòuliǎn . "
pairs.english: Carrying apparatus doesn't mean showing it off everywhere.”
pairs.hanzi: 不能为了带来器具，就处处要它露脸。”

pairs.target: luó dí búzài wèn , xiān bǎ néng jiá de liǎngchù gùdìng .
pairs.english: Luodi asked no more, first securing the two accessible spots.
pairs.hanzi: 罗荻不再问，先把能夹的两处固定。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi tì tā fúzhù dìyīkuài mùliào , liǎng réntóu yícì méi bǐ shuí shǒukuài , děng jiǎo duì shàng cái yājǐn .
pairs.english: Tavi steadied the first board; for once neither raced, tightening only when the corners aligned.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维替他扶住第一块木料，两人头一次没比谁手快，等角对上才压紧。

pairs.target: lún dào nà zhī duǎn kòujiàn shí , ruǎn héng ràng tǎ wéi bǎ shúxī de liǎngjiàn xiǎo tiě qǔchū .
pairs.english: For the short clasp, Ruanheng had Tavi take out the familiar iron pair.
pairs.hanzi: 轮到那只短扣件时，阮衡让塔维把熟悉的两件小铁取出。

pairs.target: zhěngjiàn , tǐjī jìhào , jiēchùmiàn hé qiǎn bì wén zhúyī héduì , tái jiǎo yǔ xiànwèi lìng chá .
pairs.english: Whole pieces, volume marks, contact surfaces and shallow closed grooves were checked individually, bench feet and stops separately.
pairs.hanzi: 整件、体积记号、接触面和浅闭纹逐一核对，台脚与限位另查。

pairs.target: xiān jiā qīngzǎi kàn yuánlái de wèiyí , xièxià , zài kàn huí bu huí yuányàng .
pairs.english: Light loading established baseline movement, then unloading checked return.
pairs.hanzi: 先加轻载看原来的位移，卸下，再看回不回原样。

pairs.target: dìfāng mòshēng , dòngzuò què bìng méiyǒu yīncǐ biànchéng lìng yìmén běnshì .
pairs.english: An unfamiliar place didn't make this a different skill.
pairs.hanzi: 地方陌生，动作却并没有因此变成另一门本事。

pairs.target: ruǎn héng shuāngshǒu jiēchù , yípiàn tiě de xiǎngyìng qīngqīng biàn le , lìng yípiàn zuò xiāngfǎn de bǔcháng .
pairs.english: Ruanheng touched both pieces; one iron response shifted slightly, the other compensating oppositely.
pairs.hanzi: 阮衡双手接触，一片铁的响应轻轻变了，另一片作相反的补偿。

pairs.target: jiá kǒu ràngkāi , sōngshǒu hòu de tíngliú zhī gòu luó dí bǎ xiāo sòngrù .
pairs.english: The fixture opened; the pause after release barely let Luodi insert the pin.
pairs.hanzi: 夹口让开，松手后的停留只够罗荻把销送入。

pairs.target: tā méi děng dìyīshēng bǎizhēn , biàn liǎngchù chóngxīn pèng huíqù , shōudiào biànhuà .
pairs.english: Before the first pendulum click, Ruanheng recontacted both points and canceled.
pairs.hanzi: 他没等第一声摆针，便两处重新碰回去，收掉变化。

pairs.target: xiāo tóu kòuhǎo hòu , pǔtōng jiégòu cái bǎ dōngxī liúzhù .
pairs.english: The fastened pin head then held the assembly mechanically.
pairs.hanzi: 销头扣好后，普通结构才把东西留住。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi kànzhe nà yíxià , jiānbǎng bùzhībùjué bēng le qǐlái .
pairs.english: Tavi's shoulders tensed unconsciously watching.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维看着那一下，肩膀不知不觉绷了起来。

pairs.target: ruǎn héng jiào tā bǎ xièzài de dúshù bàochū , zài jiǎnchá huíchéng .
pairs.english: Ruanheng asked him to report unloaded readings and then check the return.
pairs.hanzi: 阮衡叫他把卸载的读数报出，再检查回程。

pairs.target: tā gǎnjǐn dītóu kàn , yuánlái de xiàn duìqí , cái bǎ nà diǎn gēnzhe shīshù de rén yíkuàiér jǐnzhāng de jìn sōngkāi .
pairs.english: Seeing the original lines align, Tavi finally relaxed his sympathetic tension.
pairs.hanzi: 他赶紧低头看，原来的线对齐，才把那点跟着施术的人一块儿紧张的劲松开。

pairs.target: méiyǒu shuí jiào tā gǔzhǎng .
pairs.english: Nobody asked for applause.
pairs.hanzi: 没有谁叫他鼓掌。

pairs.target: mùjiàng duān zhe chá guòlái , xiān kàn kòujiàn fān miàn yǒuméiyǒu máobiān , zài wèn nà chù shēn bú jìn luógǎn de wèizhì , xiàhuí néng bunéng huàn yìzhǒng zuòfǎ , miǎnde měicì dōu yào zhǎo suǒ lǐ de rén lái .
pairs.english: The carpenter came with tea, checked the clasp's reverse for burrs, then asked about another method for the awkward spot next time, avoiding a call to the office every time.
pairs.hanzi: 木匠端着茶过来，先看扣件翻面有没有毛边，再问那处伸不进螺杆的位置，下回能不能换一种做法，免得每次都要找所里的人来。

pairs.target: ruǎn héng shuō néng yánjiū , jīntiān xiān bǎ chǐcùn liú quán .
pairs.english: Ruanheng would consider it, keeping all dimensions today.
pairs.hanzi: 阮衡说能研究，今天先把尺寸留全。

pairs.target: tā méi yīnwèi gāng zuò wán yícì jiè xìng , jiù bǎ nà jù tìdài bànfǎ dàngchéng tiǎoxìn .
pairs.english: He didn't treat the alternative as an insult to his casting.
pairs.hanzi: 他没因为刚做完一次借性，就把那句替代办法当成挑衅。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi hūrán yǒudiǎn bùhǎoyìsi .
pairs.english: Tavi felt embarrassed.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维忽然有点不好意思。

pairs.target: zìjǐ hái zài xiǎng nǎ tiān yě néng zuò dé zhèyàng shú , mùjiàng què yǐjīng xiǎng xià yícì búyòng děng tāmen lái .
pairs.english: He was still dreaming of such fluency, while the carpenter already sought independence from their visits.
pairs.hanzi: 自己还在想哪天也能做得这样熟，木匠却已经想下一次不用等他们来。

pairs.target: bàngwǎn zhījià dàidào jiē kǒushì bǎi , pái miàn yí lì qǐlái , luó dí biàn dàxiào .
pairs.english: At dusk they positioned the sign in the street. As soon as it stood, Luodi laughed.
pairs.hanzi: 傍晚支架带到街口试摆，牌面一立起来，罗荻便大笑。

pairs.target: zì méicuò , jiàntóu yě méicuò , zhǐshì pái gānghǎo dǎngzhù hòumiàn mài bǐng de tān .
pairs.english: The words and arrow were correct, but the sign hid a flatbread stall.
pairs.hanzi: 字没错，箭头也没错，只是牌刚好挡住后面卖饼的摊。

pairs.target: tānzhǔ bào zhe miànpén chūlái , wèn jǐwèi shìbushì dǎsuàn tì tā shōutān .
pairs.english: The vendor emerged holding his dough bowl: were they closing his business for him?
pairs.hanzi: 摊主抱着面盆出来，问几位是不是打算替他收摊。

pairs.target: shū yàn zǒu guòlái , xiān bǎ pái wǎng pángbiān nuó , mùjiàng kàn le kàn tiān , gāncuì bǎ yìbiān jiǎo suōhuí yìdiǎn .
pairs.english: Shuyan moved the sign aside; the carpenter glanced at the sky and shortened one leg's reach.
pairs.hanzi: 舒砚走过来，先把牌往旁边挪，木匠看了看天，干脆把一边脚缩回一点。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi xiǎngqǐ zǎoshàng nà zhāng bèi dǎo guòlái de tú , méi zài juéde shuí gǎi wèizhì jiùshì shuí tuīfān le shuí .
pairs.english: Remembering the reversed drawing, Tavi no longer thought repositioning meant overturning someone's work.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维想起早上那张被倒过来的图，没再觉得谁改位置就是谁推翻了谁。

pairs.target: tāmen zhàn dào rén zǒulái de dìfāng zài kàn .
pairs.english: They checked from approaching pedestrians' view.
pairs.hanzi: 他们站到人走来的地方再看。

pairs.target: chē gāi tíng de kòngdì kàndéqīng , shí yán yě méi bèi zhàn , mài bǐng de rén zhōngyú kěn cóng pái hòu tàn chūtóu , shuō zì dǎo xiě dé búcuò .
pairs.english: The cart stopping space was clear, the stone edge free, and the vendor finally peered around to compliment the lettering.
pairs.hanzi: 车该停的空地看得清，石沿也没被占，卖饼的人终于肯从牌后探出头，说字倒写得不错。

pairs.target: luó dí dīshēng wèn tǎ wéi , zhè suàn shuí de gōngláo .
pairs.english: Luodi quietly asked Tavi who deserved credit.
pairs.hanzi: 罗荻低声问塔维，这算谁的功劳。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi xiǎng shuō xiězì de rén , yòu kànkàn nà jǐshuāng zhān le bùtóng ní de xié , zuìhòu zhī shuō , xiān bié jiàomài bǐng de rén jì zánmen de míngzì .
pairs.english: Tavi almost said the letterer, then saw their differently muddied shoes. “First, don't give the vendor reason to remember our names.”
pairs.hanzi: 塔维想说写字的人，又看看那几双沾了不同泥的鞋，最后只说，先别叫卖饼的人记咱们的名字。

pairs.target: huí yuànlǐ shōu qìjù shí , ruǎn héng ràng tā míngtiān zài àn tóng yítào dōngxī zuò yíbiàn zhǔnbèi .
pairs.english: Packing up, Ruanheng told him to prepare the same setup tomorrow.
pairs.hanzi: 回院里收器具时，阮衡让他明天再按同一套东西做一遍准备。

pairs.target: ruò tiáojiàn dōu hé , zìjǐ yě wěn , zhǔnxǔ tā zài yǎnqián zuò yìzhī ; bù wěn jiù zhàoyàng yòng biéde fāngfǎ .
pairs.english: If conditions and steadiness were right, he could do one under supervision; otherwise another method.
pairs.hanzi: 若条件都合、自己也稳，准许他在眼前做一只；不稳就照样用别的方法。

pairs.target: tā diǎntóu , bǎ jīntiān bào guò de yuánshǐ dúshù jiá zài míngzǎo dìyīyè , méi xiān zài hòumiàn xiěchéng le .
pairs.english: Tavi nodded, filing today's baseline readings first for tomorrow, without writing success in advance.
pairs.hanzi: 他点头，把今天报过的原始读数夹在明早第一页，没先在后面写成了。
